title: Apollonian packing with prime curvatures
plain: In the integral Apollonian packing with curvatures (−1, 2, 2, 3), show every large prime is the largest prime factor of some circle's curvature.
math: For the $(-1,2,2,3)$ Apollonian packing with curvature multiset $\mathcal{K}$, prove $\{P(k):k\in\mathcal{K}\}$ contains all sufficiently large primes.
